sdk.major: public SDK API break, runtime ABI incompatibility, or unsupported migration requirement
sdk.minor: new supported SDK/runtime capability within the current ABI
sdk.patch: bug fix, security fix, documentation correction, or compatibility fixture expansion

runtimeAbi.compatibility: minor and patch releases must remain compatible with ABI v1; ABI breaks require SDK major

protocolAbi.compatibility: runtime protocol ABI must be recorded in release notes when changed

node.policy: patch candidates are rehearsed before promotion; major line changes require a compatibility lane

npm.policy: single package-manager promotion per release candidate

pnpm.policy: pnpm 12 remains held until browser runtime supports its entry contract

browser.baseline: Chromium family with COOP/COEP and SharedArrayBuffer
browser.policy: qualify current stable and previous two stable Chromium releases before beta or stable

endOfSupport.overlap: keep the previous supported Node/npm/pnpm baseline for one minor release after promotion
endOfSupport.exceptions: critical security fixes may shorten overlap with a documented mitigation

candidateRehearsal: record source URL, integrity, and SHA256 before running fixtures
run protocol, node-runtime, browser-host, package-manager, preview, browser, Vite, SDK consumer suites
keep candidate status as rehearsed-not-promoted until product gates and rollback artifacts are updated
record promotion or hold reason in release notes and manifests
